flags.text: Revenue compounded 47.7% a year over 3 years
Weak cash conversion: 3-year operating cash flow is -0.71× net profit
Free cash flow was negative over 3 years (Rs -3,167 Cr)
Debtor days jumped from 77 to 154 in 2026
Other income is 31% of pre-tax profit in 2026

items.quote: So, in terms of revenue, I think last quarter is going to be a busy quarter for us, and including the last quarter for FY '26, we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum and mainly driven by EMS revenues.
items.target: FY26 full year revenue to cross minimum INR 4,000 crores
items.actual: FY26 revenue Rs 3,626 Cr vs Rs 4,000 Cr minimum guided (-9%)
items.note: The management missed the revised revenue target of Rs 4,000 Cr for FY26.

items.quote: So, you can expect about 85 days and better net working capital.
items.target: Net working capital targeted at 85 days or better by year end
items.actual: FY26 net working capital days of 133 vs target of 85 days or better
items.note: The company's working capital days significantly deteriorated to 133 days compared to the 85-day target.

items.quote: And going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
items.target: Consolidated operating cash flow to be positive by end of FY26
items.actual: FY26 operating cash flow was Rs -600 Cr vs positive target
items.note: Operating cash flow remained deeply negative instead of turning positive as promised.

items.quote: So going forward, we will make sure that before this year is over, we get rid of these receivables with appropriate financing so that it's not in our books, because these pertain to almost like the annuity type of payments, which are like home loan payments and similar to that.

items.actual: Debtor days increased from 77 in FY25 to 154 in FY26
items.note: Instead of removing long-term receivables, debtor days doubled, indicating an inability to clear the annuity payments from the books.

items.quote: And then, of course, in the second half, we also plan some execution, which will be of the nature of about INR300-odd crores.
items.target: H2 FY26 smart metering revenue execution of about INR 300 crores
items.note: Smart metering revenue specific execution is not separately detailed in the annual financial data.

items.quote: So we don't want to commit on the top-line number, but whatever the market growth is there, because of the strategic initiatives of keeping the inventory, keeping the manufacturing flexible, and having a very committed people, we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.
items.note: The deadline for FY27 growth targets is at the end of the current fiscal year.

items.quote: Having said that, we have taken up at all levels in the GridCrest business, and though late, we have got about INR200 crores of money in the first week of July, which gives us the confidence that whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.
items.target: Reduce negative cash flow by 70-80% by Q3 and reach positive cash flow by year-end
items.note: The deadline for turning cash flow positive by the end of FY27 has not been reached.

items.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
items.target: Commercial revenue booking from OSAT and PCB starting in Q3 and Q4 FY27
items.note: These targets relate to FY27 performance and project milestones that are currently ongoing.

items.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business. Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

promises.credibility: Management has demonstrated a poor track record of delivery, consistently missing targets related to revenue, cash flow, and working capital efficiency [T3.1, T3.3, T3.4, T4.6]. They have a tendency to revise targets downward only after missing them or encountering delays [T2.4], raising concerns about the reliability of their forward-looking guidance.

what_they_do.text: Kaynes Technology India Limited is an integrated Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) enterprise offering end-to-end services from conceptual product design, OEM/ODM manufacturing, and semiconductor packaging to global lifecycle support. The company has transitioned from a service-led EMS provider into a product-driven enterprise delivering high-mix, high-value, and complex electronic assemblies.

customers_and_markets.text: Serves high-entry-barrier end markets including Automotive & EVs, Industrial Electronics, Railways, Medical, Aerospace & Defence, and IT/Consumer Electronics.
Key global customers and partners include Alpha & Omega Semiconductor, L&T Semiconductor, Infineon, Siemens, Mahindra, Honeywell, Otis, and Eaton.

recent_developments.text: Operationalised its greenfield OSAT unit in Sanand, Gujarat, commercially delivering India's first Multi-Chip Modules (MCMs) and securing Financial Support Agreement (FSA) approval under the India Semiconductor Mission.
Setting up a ₹14,000 Mn High-Density Interconnect (HDI) PCB manufacturing plant in Chennai capable of producing up to 74-layer boards, targeted to commence commercial production in Q3 FY27.

Entered the space tech domain by prototyping its first 3U CubeSat satellite and initiating titanium gas bottle manufacturing for ISRO and DRDO flight projects through subsidiary Crio Precision and Aerotech Technologies.
Formed a strategic partnership between Kaynes Semicon and Mitsui to target semiconductor packaging market opportunities in Japan.

about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.
